Firebase JS SDK 10.7.1 (Apache-2.0), the compat browser builds, copied
unchanged from the npm package `firebase@10.7.1` (`npm pack firebase@10.7.1`).
Served from this site instead of www.gstatic.com so the sign-in page loads no
third-party script. To upgrade, copy the same two files from a newer package
and change the folder name and the two <script> tags in ledger/index.html.
